name: TMDB Link Fixer
overview: Checks existing TMDB movie and show links, compares possible replacements, and applies only replacements explicitly confirmed by an administrator.

releases.release_notes: Adds explicit AniDB-to-TMDB episode mapping before a manually confirmed replacement. Existing show mappings can be repaired without replacing the show link. Multiple AniDB episodes linked to the same TMDB movie or special are grouped for review, while all replacements remain strictly manual.

## Changes

- Use the configured plugin TMDB credential for manual movie and show searches.
- Include restricted/adult TMDB results so legitimate matches such as adult titles can be reviewed.
- Supplement Shoko's animation-filtered automatic matches with a broad, unverified TMDB title search.
- Keep movie and show search results independent when one TMDB endpoint temporarily fails.
- Persist valid, missing, and alternate-type validation responses for four days to avoid repeated checks.
- Add an explicit **Ignore cached results** option for forced revalidation.
- Show an explanatory message for empty searches instead of an empty result area.
- Stamp official Shoko plugin identity, runtime, channel, tag, and source metadata in release archives.

No links are replaced automatically. Every candidate remains inert until an administrator reviews the exact AniDB and TMDB IDs, checks the confirmation box, and explicitly accepts it.

## TMDB Link Fixer v0.1.3

Fixes "Check all links" appearing to do nothing.

### What changed
- "Check all links" now starts and tracks a scan. The page's request helper auto-retried on any `202` response, which was meant for the idempotent `/links` refresh. A `POST /scan` returns `202` when it successfully starts, so the auto-retry re-submitted the request and hit the "scan already running" guard (409), throwing and leaving the page looking idle — even though the scan was running server-side. The `202` retry is now limited to `GET` requests, so "Check all links" starts the scan and the page polls and shows progress (X / 8091 checked, valid/problem counts) until it finishes.

No behavior change to replacement safety: links are only changed after an administrator explicitly selects one exact candidate and confirms it.

## TMDB Link Fixer v0.1.2

Fixes the plugin page showing `undefined` for every link after v0.1.1 unblocked the page's data load.

### What changed
- **Link cards render correctly again.** Shoko serializes plugin-API JSON as **PascalCase keys with enum values as integers** (its global Newtonsoft config ignores the model's string-enum converter). The page was reading camelCase string fields, so every card showed `undefined` for the series title, AniDB ID, and TMDB link details — only the count loaded.
- The page's request helper now **normalizes every API response**: it lowercases the JSON keys to camelCase and maps the `Kind` / `RedirectKind` / `Health` enum integers back to their string labels (`Movie`/`Show`, `NotChecked`/`Valid`/…). This makes the summary counts and filters work too.
- Validated against the real 8091-link library: no undefined fields, correct valid/problem counts.

No behavior change to replacement safety: links are only changed after an administrator explicitly selects one exact candidate and confirms it.

## TMDB Link Fixer v0.1.1

Fixes the embedded WebUI page so its admin-gated actions work, and removes the long first-page-load stall.

### What changed
- **Page now authenticates.** The plugin page previously sent no Shoko API key, so every action (`/links`, `/scan`, `/search`, `/accept`) returned HTTP 401 from the embedded WebUI and the page appeared dead. The page now reads the API key from the Shoko WebUI session (`localStorage['apiSession']`) and sends it as the `apikey` header on every request — the same mechanism Shoko's own WebUI uses. A clear notice is shown if no session is present.
- **`/links` no longer blocks for minutes.** On a large library, building the full link list synchronously on the request thread took a very long time (minutes) and stalled the page. The snapshot is now built once in the background on first request, cached, and re-built when a scan or an accepted replacement changes the data. While the background build is in progress `/links` returns `202` and the page retries, so load is responsive.
- **Scan button disabled while the list is still initializing**, so an early scan can't wipe the in-progress build.

No behavior change to replacement safety: links are only ever changed after an administrator explicitly selects one exact candidate and confirms it. A scan only compares and suggests.

Initial release of the TMDB Link Fixer plugin.

- Scans every TMDB movie and show link without modifying it.
- Detects valid, missing (invalid), and redirected targets.
- Suggests replacements via auto-match and manual search.
- Shows posters on hover and a three-poster comparison before confirming.
- Applies a replacement only after an explicit administrator confirmation. No automatic link changes.
